allowedWork: Repair the two documented generation and explanation baseline drifts.
Add a thin shared result projection and router over domain-owned frontends.
Route exact canonical equation and code requests without changing approved choreography.

Build one exact fixed-camera Graph3D saddle-parameter frontend, asset, WebGL and SVG projection, and Catalogue route.
Add pinned conformance fixtures, stable scoped visual commands, Catalogue collection disclosure, direct URLs, Review evidence, tests, and project memory.
disallowedWork: Do not build arbitrary graph formula parsers, a universal semantic IR, or a universal renderer.
Do not add a live LLM or network dependency to the gallery.
Do not compile arbitrary code variants into counterfeit animation artifacts.
Do not migrate Scheme, the public TypeScript lesson, or the global application theme.
Do not change derivative choreography, the operator scope-box treatment, integration, trigonometric rewrites, inequalities, limits, or root families.
Do not claim Graph2D or Graph3D family promotion from one exemplar.
Do not modify the existing dirty economics lesson, generated economics publication, or editor-animation-visuals browser test.
goal: Ship a production-backed curated gallery with the approved logarithmic solve, bounded Graph2D translation, bounded Graph3D saddle transformation, reviewed programming light mode, and an honest typed gap through one governed generation and hosting envelope.
commitCadence: Commit every independently reversible verified slice with exact path staging and completed Theseus evidence; emit loop status at slice starts, completions, commit boundaries, and stops.
stopConditions: Stop at s14 for human cross-language theme review before shared code-theme promotion.
Stop at s20 for human Graph2D visual review before Graph3D work.
Stop at s26 for human Graph3D visual review before gallery assembly.
Stop at s29 for human curated-gallery visual review before release closeout.

Stop if a requested domain requires arbitrary formula parsing, a universal semantic IR or renderer, counterfeit code animation, a live network or model dependency, or other scope outside the approved proposal.

Stop on failed semantic authority, deterministic lifecycle, renderer ownership, accessibility, lazy-loading, fallback, architecture, or production-closure evidence that cannot be repaired within the active slice.

Stop before modifying protected economics files, the editor-animation-visuals browser test, approved derivative choreography, Scheme, public TypeScript lesson behavior, or the global application theme.
Stop whenever subjective visual judgment is required or a second caller fails to justify the proposed shared boundary.

slices.title: Bounded-Graph2D-function-request
slices.summary: Added an exact parameter-only Graph2D monic-quadratic right-translation request and frontend authority. The boundary accepts only the pinned family, operation, shifts, real-line domain, preservation set, frontend, and capability; formulas, equation routing, presentation fields, arbitrary shifts, and other topologies return typed repairs. Coverage now satisfies only the frontend requirement while operation, recipe, exemplar, and corpus remain incomplete.

slices.title: Graph2D-semantic-trace-and-asset
slices.summary: Compiled the pinned Graph2D request into exact source y=x^2 and target y=(x-2)^2 expression states, a fixed semantic coordinate context, stable curve/vertex/sample identities, total typed correspondence, grounded explanation claims, and a renderer-neutral AnimationAsset. Playhead-derived frames preserve (u+h,u^2), direct seek, mirrored rewind, static endpoints, and accessibility; semantic focus names the curve and points while axes remain context. No SVG, DOM, Catalogue route, or family-promotion claim was added.

slices.title: Graph2D-SVG-runtime-adapter
slices.summary: Implemented a source-native retained SVG adapter over the renderer-neutral Graph2D asset. Renderer-owned sampling and responsive projection move one persistent curve plus vertex and two sample points; fixed axes and two ticks remain contextual; source and target equations stay legible while salience transfers; the adapter patches paths/points/descriptions deterministically, owns no clock or formula parser, exposes exact accessibility text, and disposes through the shared Graph2D lifecycle. Optical values remain exemplar-local until s20 review.

slices.title: Graph2D-generation-and-Catalogue-route
slices.summary: Routed the exact Graph2D request through the shared router as a compiled artifact; enrolled it in the lazy graph pack, Catalogue metadata, and conformance ledgers; registered the exact retained SVG adapter; and added stable browser evidence for direct routing, seek and rewind, persistent curve identity, fixed axes, responsive fit, and accessibility. Optical review remains at s20.

slices.title: Graph2D-visual-checkpoint
slices.summary: Human review approved the corrected Graph2D checkpoint by requesting resume. The exemplar retains three semantic correspondence points while painting smaller filled support witnesses and a slightly more salient vertex; all visible graph labels use KaTeX under the strict shared text-ownership policy. Commit 2a3d63265 is the approved rollback unit.

slices.title: Bounded-Graph3D-scene-request
slices.summary: Added the exact parameter-only Graph3D saddle request for denominator 4 to 8 over the fixed [-3,3] x/y domain. The request preserves family, identity, topology, axes, and camera state; rejects formulas, arbitrary parameters, camera instructions, geometry, paint, and sampling as typed repairs; and satisfies only the declared Graph3D frontend evidence gap while retaining operation, recipe, renderer, and corpus work.

slices.title: Graph3D-semantic-trace-and-frames
slices.summary: Compiled the pinned Graph3D request into exact denominator-4 and denominator-8 saddle states over the unchanged square domain, with stable surface, axis, camera, topology, and ridge/origin/valley witness identities. Added grounded explanation claims, total correspondence, a renderer-neutral AnimationAsset, and playhead-derived frames that preserve fixed camera and topology under direct seek and mirrored rewind. No SVG, WebGL, DOM, Catalogue, or family-promotion authority was added.

slices.title: Bounded-Graph3D-host-registry
slices.summary: Added an exact saddle host contract and enrolled only the reviewed saddle asset beside the existing mesh-to-donut asset in Graph3D capability selection. The host projects one shared clock into immutable source, target, and current semantic surface truth; retains fixed camera and topology; declares the existing two-context lease, lazy Three backend, continuous semantic SVG fallback, and accessible single-image policy; and fails closed on metadata or asset drift. No renderer paint or Catalogue asset registration was added.

slices.title: Graph3D-WebGL-and-SVG-paint
slices.summary: Materialized the current semantic denominator into one renderer-neutral Graph3D frame consumed by both continuous SVG fallback and lazy Three/WebGL paint. Sampling is renderer-owned at 21 by 21, the camera and topology remain fixed, every visible graph label is KaTeX-owned, the exact saddle adapter reuses the shared clock and two-context lease lifecycle, and optical values remain provisional until the slice 26 human checkpoint.

slices.title: Graph3D-generation-and-Catalogue-route
slices.summary: Routed the exact fixed-camera saddle denominator request through the shared generation envelope as a compiled artifact; enrolled it in the existing lazy graph pack, Catalogue metadata, hostability projection, and generated conformance ledgers; and added a stable Chromium command proving direct URL restoration, exact adapter selection, shared-clock seek and rewind, fixed camera and surface identity, responsive 21 by 21 sampling, KaTeX-only visible graph text, semantic SVG fallback, and WebGL lease release.
